headline.en: Give your notes a stable place in every conversation.
headline.zh: 让笔记以稳定前缀进入每次对话。

sub.en: Memoir reads local text notes, assembles a deterministic prefix, and can send that prefix with conversation turns to a configured DeepSeek-compatible endpoint.
sub.zh: Memoir 读取本地文本笔记并生成确定性前缀，也可将该前缀与对话轮次发送给配置的 DeepSeek 兼容端点。

body.en: The manifest records the assembled sources.
body.zh: 清单记录实际拼接的来源。

body.en: Input traversal order does not change assembled bytes.
body.zh: 遍历顺序不改变拼接字节。

body.en: Ingestion and prefix assembly need no chat request.
body.zh: 导入与前缀拼接无需聊天请求。

title.en: Run it on a complete example

note.en: Assemble only the four shipped example notes, reverse their input order and compare the resulting prefix bytes.
note.zh: 仅拼接随仓四份示例笔记，反转输入顺序后比较生成的前缀字节。

steps.label: Recorded run
steps.body: Assemble the shipped example notes twice in reversed input order and compare bytes. No chat call, provider cache hit, billing or memory recall is measured.

body.en: Assemble only the four shipped example notes, reverse their input order and compare the resulting prefix bytes.
body.zh: 仅拼接随仓四份示例笔记，反转输入顺序后比较生成的前缀字节。

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/memoir.git
cd memoir
uv venv .venv
uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e .
source .venv/bin/activate

limitations.en: Stable bytes do not guarantee a provider cache hit or a particular cost. The demo makes no API call.
limitations.zh: 字节稳定不保证提供方缓存命中或具体费用；示例不调用 API。

limitations.en: Online chat sends the full ingested note content to the configured endpoint. Review the source folder before using chat.
limitations.zh: 在线 chat 会把已导入的完整笔记内容发送给配置端点，使用前应检查来源目录。

limitations.en: Token counts are estimates and full-prefix chat remains bounded by the selected model context window.
limitations.zh: token 数是估计值，完整前缀聊天仍受所选模型上下文窗口限制。

body.en: A personal note collection is difficult to reuse if every session assembles it differently. Keep one ordered prefix and a source manifest so you can inspect what will be supplied to the model.
body.zh: 如果每次会话都以不同方式拼接笔记，个人资料就难以复用。保留有序前缀与来源清单，可以检查实际要提供给模型的内容。

body.en: ingest walks supported note files and hashes their content. prefix sorts sources by relative path and content hash, assembles stable framing, and records a manifest. session stores conversation turns; deepseek_client sends the full prefix and turns when chat is used.
body.zh: ingest 遍历支持的笔记文件并计算内容哈希；prefix 按相对路径和哈希排序，以稳定边界拼接并记录清单。session 保存对话轮次；chat 时 deepseek_client 发送完整前缀与轮次。

body.en: ingest walks supported note files and hashes their content. prefix sorts sources by relative path and content hash, assembles stable framing, and records a manifest. session stores conversation turns; deepseek_client sends the full prefix and turns when chat is used.
body.zh: ingest 遍历支持的笔记文件并计算内容哈希；prefix 按相对路径和哈希排序，以稳定边界拼接并记录清单。session 保存对话轮次；chat 时 deepseek_client 发送完整前缀与轮次。

body.en: The following routes are implemented in the source. Choose the input that matches your task and keep the resulting artifact with your project.
body.zh: 以下路径已有源码实现。按任务选择输入，并把生成的结果与项目一起保存。

body.en: MEMOIR_HOME selects prefix.txt, manifest.yaml and session.json storage. DEEPSEEK_API_KEY enables chat; DEEPSEEK_MODEL and DEEPSEEK_BASE_URL select the online model and endpoint. The cost command uses the repository pricing snapshot, which may differ from current provider billing.
body.zh: MEMOIR_HOME 指定 prefix.txt、manifest.yaml 与 session.json 的存储位置。DEEPSEEK_API_KEY 用于 chat；DEEPSEEK_MODEL 与 DEEPSEEK_BASE_URL 指定模型和端点。cost 命令使用仓库内价格快照，可能与当前实际计费不同。

body.en: The CLI exposes the following operations. Commands after the example use your own paths or identifiers.
body.zh: CLI 提供以下操作。示例之外的命令需要替换成你的文件路径或标识。

details.code:
memoir ingest examples/notes
memoir status
# Online chat requires your configured endpoint and API key:
memoir chat
